source_sentences: Double Counting At most 2 of the courses used to fulfill the minor requirements may be counted towards any other major or minor program.

This rule does not apply to 17-214 (a prerequisite for the minor) or courses counted for general education requirements, nor does it apply to double-counting with the SCS General Education requirements.
